preregistration_russian_analogues.unit_convention: citation mass aggregated by siglum (Sources.Sokr normalised), never by Sources.Id; denominators recomputed at run time on a dated re-clone

R1.hypothesis: citation mass per cited siglum is extreme-right-skewed, with the Biblical/Psalter-class sigla concentrating in the top decile and a near-zero tail; uniform overlap/mass across sigla falsifies A68's coverage structure in this tradition
R1.denominators: 24,405 examples; joined subset 10,318 (42.3%); siglum universe from distinct normalised Sokr in the joined subset; tail defined as bottom 50% of sigla by mass
R1.falsifier: top-decile mass share < 2x uniform expectation, or decile shares linear in rank

R2.hypothesis: declared-complete canonical texts (Bible-class: Bibl. siglum group) show an order-of-magnitude citation-density advantage over same-genre selective sources — with the explicit caveat that the dump carries NO declared complete-excerption list; if no declaration is recoverable from the printed dictionary's front matter (out-of-band source), R2 is reclassified UNTESTABLE-ON-THIS-SUBSTRATE before any run, not silently adapted
R2.denominators: Bibl.-group siglum mass vs same-genre (Bible-and-apocrypha flagged) non-canonical sources; density per source row

R3.hypothesis: the database's S..T slice is a partial apparatus: source-density rankings computed on the S-half vs the T-half of the SAME dump diverge materially (Spearman rho materially < 1 on shared sigla); instability of rankings across the two half-slices demonstrates that partial-apparatus results are apparatus artefacts — the direct in-dump test of the ONP a-em 2.6x lesson
R3.denominators: S-initial vs T-initial word subsets (Words.Word1 prefix split); shared-siglum citation vectors

R4.hypothesis: headword-, meaning-, example- and siglum-weighted source rankings diverge materially; coincidence across the four weightings overturns the claim that metric choice carries information
R4.denominators: 6,307 words / 8,858 meanings / 24,405 examples / siglum universe as above; divergence metric pre-declared: Spearman rho + top-100 overlap (Jaccard)

R5.hypothesis: which DECLARED sources (Sources rows) are never exercised by any joined example is predictable from their genre/date/Lang profile (logistic model, genre+century predictors), not random — the declared-vs-exercised asymmetry is structure, not noise; additionally the 14,087 unjoined examples form a systematic (not random) residue whose meaningID/sourceId pattern predicts dump-generation artefacts
R5.denominators: 8,400 declared sources; exercised-set = distinct normalised sigla among joined examples; unjoined-residue = 24,405 - 10,318
